title: The metro railways (construction of works) act, 1978
full_text: The metro railways (construction of works) act, 1978 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act Number: 33 Enactment Date: 1978-08-21 Act Year: 1978 Short Title: The metro railways (construction of works) act, 1978 Long Title: An Act to provide for the construction of works relating to metro railways in the metropolitan cities and for matters connected therewith. Department: Urban Development and Housing Department Enforcement Date: 01-02-1979 Type: STATE Location: Rajasthan Notification: 1st February, 1979, vide notification No. S.O. 412(E), dated 20th January, 1979, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3 (ii).
